title: Bulb resistance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the resistance of a single bulb using R = U²/P with given 220V and 60W.

title: Primary voltage determination
description: Essential: Correctly applies transformer turns ratio (3:1) to find primary voltage from secondary voltage of 220V.

title: Secondary current calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes total secondary current by summing power of all bulbs (100 × 60W) and dividing by secondary voltage.

title: Primary current determination
description: Important: Correctly applies transformer current ratio (inverse of turns ratio) to find primary current from secondary current.

title: Parallel circuit understanding
description: Important: Recognizes that all bulbs operate at rated voltage when connected in parallel to transformer secondary.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains proper units throughout calculations and presents final answers with correct units.

title: Incorrect ratio application
description: Pitfall: Uses turns ratio directly (instead of inversely) for current calculation, or voltage ratio inversely.

title: Power calculation error
description: Pitfall: Fails to multiply by 100 bulbs when calculating total power or current in secondary circuit.
